messages.author: 87af66513dd507f5
messages.subject: Problem in marker ordering
parts:
Hi Karl,
I am having trouble in ordering markers into correct order in my largest linkage group (165 SNPs). I have dataset of 76 haploid males from a single diploid mother (exhibit Haplodiploidy). I obtained this group after merging some groups together and then filtering out the duplicates [nodupLG1.csv]. All 165 makers stays in the same linkage group at RF 0.3 and LOD of 3. The pairwise RF-LOD plot before ordering show multiple subgroups [beforeordering.JPG] and after ordering it show gaps [afterordering.JPG and linkagemap.PDF]. i had some similar cases with other linkage groups which after ordering 2-3 times gave me good result but this one did not. I tried DropOneMarker but did not help. I have not used ripple so far but I if I am not wrong I think that's more for local fine-tuning. 
Is there anything I can do to remove the gaps or I unnecessarily merged groups that were supposed to be separate?

Also, another quick question about gaps: What is the lengths of gap usually acceptable in linkage maps (I have upto 28 cM in my a few other groups)?

Thank you so much for your time and help!

Prashant

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Problem in marker ordering
parts:
The spots off the diagonal seem to indicate groups of markers that need to be inverted. I would try to figure out what they are and invert them by hand. 

The tools for map construction in R/qtl are pretty primitive. You might look at other packages, such as ASMap, https://cran.r-project.org/package=ASMap

karl
